estimates.base_rate_construction: own-product negative conceded in 3 of 23 prints (3Q25 D006, 4Q25 D017/D018, 1Q26 D035; all RNPL cancellations, all 'yes, but net positive'); Laplace 0.16/print over two opportunities (5 Nov; Feb print with the 10-K filed the same day) = 0.29; x0.7 discount because host attrition has an alternative attribution and the fee-specific record is 0/3 -> 0.20
estimates.decomposition_construction: 0.30 (material observable churn by Jan 2027; London reviewed-home 5.6-6.4% vs panel 3.3-4.2%, no pre-period) x 0.45 (attributed to the fee on the RNPL template) = 0.135; + 0.05 pricing/pause attribution without churn; + 0.02 <=3% disclosure; union 0.195; rev-1 +0.03 resolver branch moved to sensitivity

conventions: a forward-looking 10-K/10-Q risk-factor 'may' sentence resolves No; an observed-effect attribution resolves Yes, including the 'some hosts left / raised prices, but net positive' form
leg 2 needs a numeric or bucket disclosure implying <=3%; 'in line with nights' and level-only disclosures resolve No
window: 5 Nov letter/call/10-Q, Feb letter/call, FY26 10-K (same day as the Feb print per the FY25 precedent, not an independent opportunity), conferences and 8-Ks in between
